    private void SetCommandInProgressWarning(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.CommandExecutionAdmissionDenialReason reason)

    private string ResolveShellLocalized(string key, string fallback)
    {

            return localized.ResourceNotFound || string.IsNullOrEmpty(localized.Value) ? fallback : localized.Value;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)

            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private void OnStateChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e) {

        // Guard by correlation id so sibling forms of the same command type do not react to
        // another instance's successful submit.
        var current = LifecycleState.Value.State;
        var currentCorrelationId = LifecycleState.Value.CorrelationId;
        if (current == CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed
            && _previousLifecycleState != CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed
            && OnConfirmed.HasDelegate
            && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_submittedCorrelationId)
            && string.Equals(currentCorrelationId, _submittedCorrelationId, StringComparison.Ordinal)) {
            IsDirty = false;
            _editContext?.MarkAsUnmodified();
            _ = OnConfirmed.InvokeAsync(null);
        }
        _previousLifecycleState = current;
        InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves a field label following the AC3 precedence: an explicit

        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            // Localizer misconfiguration (missing resource manager, culture load failure) is non-fatal.
        }

        return staticLabel;
    }

    private async Task OnValidSubmitAsync()
    {
        // Story 2-2 code-review P35 — guard against invocation via RegisterExternalSubmit after form disposal.
        if (_disposed) return;
        // State-guard against rapid double-click: only allow submit from terminal or idle state.
        // (See code-review 2026-04-15, patch P19.)
        var currentState = LifecycleState.Value.State;
        if (currentState != CommandLifecycleState.Idle
            && currentState != CommandLifecycleState.Rejected
            && currentState != CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (HasClientParseErrors())
        {
            _editContext?.NotifyValidationStateChanged();
            return;
        }

        // Story 2-2 code-review P36 — allocate new CTS BEFORE awaiting BeforeSubmit so disposal can cancel it.
        CancellationTokenSource? previous = _cts;
        _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        if (previous is not null)
        {
            try { previous.Cancel(); } catch (ObjectDisposedException) { }
            previous.Dispose();
        }

        // Story 5-2 D5 — clear server-driven validation state from the prior submit (auth has already passed if a policy is in scope).
        _serverValidationMessages?.Clear();
        if (_serverFormLevelErrors.Count > 0)
        {
            _serverFormLevelErrors = System.Array.Empty<string>();
        }
        _serverWarning = null;
        _editContext?.NotifyValidationStateChanged();

        if (BeforeSubmit is not null)
        {
            await BeforeSubmit().ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (_disposed || _cts.IsCancellationRequested) return;
        }

        var admission = CommandExecutionAdmissionGate.TryAcquire(new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.CommandExecutionAdmissionRequest(
            typeof(Counter.Domain.IncrementCommand).FullName ?? nameof(Counter.Domain.IncrementCommand),
            "Send IncrementCommand"));
        if (!admission.IsAdmitted)
        {
            SetCommandInProgressWarning(admission.DenialReason);
            if (_serverWarning is not null)
            {
                CommandFeedbackPublisher.PublishWarning(_serverWarning);
            }
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
            if (Logger is not null) { LogSubmitBlockedByConcurrency(Logger, admission.DenialReason, admission.BlockingMessageId); }
            return;
        }

        var correlationId = UlidFactory.NewUlid();
        _submittedCorrelationId = correlationId;
        var cts = _cts;

        // Story 2-3 D5 — lazily activate the lifecycle bridge so ILifecycleStateService receives
        // the typed Fluxor actions. Idempotent + per-circuit; mirrors Story 2-2 D35.
        LifecycleBridgeRegistry.Ensure<IncrementCommandLifecycleBridge>();
        // Story 2-2 D35 — lazily activate the generated subscriber before the first SubmittedAction dispatch.
        LastUsedSubscriberRegistry.Ensure<IncrementCommandLastUsedSubscriber>();

        Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.SubmittedAction(correlationId, _model));
        await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandSubmitted(Logger, correlationId); }

        try
        {
            var result = await CommandService.DispatchAsync(
                _model,
                onLifecycleChange: (state, messageId) =>
                {
                    // Guard against callbacks arriving after form disposal or cancellation (patch P10).
                    if (_disposed || cts.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                    _ = InvokeAsync(() =>
                    {
                        if (_disposed || cts.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                        switch (state)
                        {
                            case CommandLifecycleState.Syncing:
                                Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.SyncingAction(correlationId));
                                break;
                            case CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed:
                                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(messageId))
                                {
                                    _ = PendingCommandState.ResolveTerminal(global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandTerminalObservation.Confirmed(messageId));
                                }
                                Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ConfirmedAction(correlationId));
                                break;
                        }
                    });
                },
                cancellationToken: cts.Token);

            // Story 9.2 — form-emit-time metadata remains limited to CorrelationId, MessageId,
            // and CommandTypeName. Row identity is registered only when a generated/runtime row
            // context cascades PendingCommandRowIdentity; raw command payloads and form values
            // must not populate ProjectionTypeName / LaneKey / EntityKey / status slots.
            global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationResult? pendingRegistration = null;
            if (string.Equals(result.Status, "Accepted", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                pendingRegistration = PendingCommandState.Register(new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistration(
                    CorrelationId: correlationId,
                    MessageId: result.MessageId,
                    CommandTypeName: typeof(Counter.Domain.IncrementCommand).FullName ?? nameof(Counter.Domain.IncrementCommand),
                    ProjectionTypeName: PendingCommandRowIdentity?.ProjectionTypeName,
                    LaneKey: PendingCommandRowIdentity?.LaneKey,
                    EntityKey: PendingCommandRowIdentity?.EntityKey,
                    ExpectedStatusSlot: PendingCommandRowIdentity?.ExpectedStatusSlot,
                    PriorStatusSlot: PendingCommandRowIdentity?.PriorStatusSlot));
                if (pendingRegistration.Status is global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.InvalidMessageId
                    or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.InvalidCorrelationId
                    or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.ConflictingMetadata)
                {
                    if (Logger is not null) { LogPendingRegistrationSkipped(Logger, correlationId, pendingRegistration.Status); }
                }
            }

            // Story 3.3 P17 / P18 / P2-P2 / P2-P3 — skip duplicate AcknowledgedAction dispatch only when:
            //   - InvalidMessageId/InvalidCorrelationId: pending registry rejected malformed identity; lifecycle has nothing to acknowledge.
            //   - ConflictingMetadata: the registration was rejected because metadata conflicts with an existing entry; the new correlationId is unknown to the pending state.
            //   - MergedTerminal with the SAME correlationId: re-mount of the original form on a terminal entry; would re-acknowledge a known-terminal lifecycle.
            // MergedTerminal with a DIFFERENT correlationId means a second form submission for the same MessageId; the new correlationId must advance through Acknowledged so its Fluxor state does not stay in Submitting.
            bool skipAcknowledged = pendingRegistration is { Status:
                global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.InvalidMessageId
                or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.InvalidCorrelationId
                or global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.ConflictingMetadata };
            if (!skipAcknowledged && pendingRegistration is { Status: global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.State.PendingCommands.PendingCommandRegistrationStatus.MergedTerminal, Entry: { } mergedEntry } && string.Equals(mergedEntry.CorrelationId, correlationId, System.StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                skipAcknowledged = true;
            }
            if (!skipAcknowledged)
            {
                Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.AcknowledgedAction(correlationId, result.MessageId));
                if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandAcknowledged(Logger, correlationId, result.MessageId); }
            }
            else
            {
                if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandAcknowledgedDispatchSkipped(Logger, pendingRegistration?.Status, correlationId); }
            }
        }
        catch (CommandValidationException ex)
        {
            // Story 5-2 D5 — server-side 400 validation. Map allowlisted fields onto the
            // ValidationMessageStore; surface unknown / global errors form-level. Lifecycle returns to Idle so the user can correct and re-submit (patch P11 mirrors the cancellation path).
            if (_editContext is not null && _serverValidationMessages is not null)
            {
                _serverFormLevelErrors = global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.Services.Validation.ServerValidationApplicator.Apply(_serverValidationMessages, ex, _serverValidationAllowlist, _model!);
                _editContext.NotifyValidationStateChanged();
            }
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
            if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandValidationFailed(Logger, correlationId, ex.Problem.Title); }
        }
        catch (CommandWarningException ex)
        {
            // Story 5-2 D6 — 403/404/429 surface through a separate warning channel. Lifecycle is
            // reset to Idle so the user can react (e.g. wait out a Retry-After) and try again.
            _serverWarning = new global::Hexalith.FrontComposer.Shell.Services.Feedback.CommandFeedbackWarning(
                ex.Kind,
                ex.Problem.Title,
                ex.Problem.Detail,
                ex.Problem.EntityLabel,
                ex.RetryAfter);
            CommandFeedbackPublisher.PublishWarning(_serverWarning);
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
            if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandWarning(Logger, ex.Kind, correlationId, ex.Problem.Title); }
        }
        catch (AuthRedirectRequiredException ex)
        {
            // Story 5-2 D8 — 401: invoke the framework auth redirector. No cache mutation, no
            // lifecycle rejection, no validation pollution. Lifecycle is reset to Idle so
            // the form does not stay locked while the host handles the redirect.
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
            if (Logger is not null) { LogAuthRedirectRequired(Logger, correlationId, ex.Message); }
            await AuthRedirector.RedirectAsync(returnUrl: null, cancellationToken: cts.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (CommandRejectedException ex)
        {
            Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.RejectedAction(correlationId, ex.Message, ex.Resolution, ex.ErrorCode, ex.ReasonCategory, ex.SuggestedAction, ex.DocsCode));
            // Notify validation pipeline so any stale error state redraws (patch P16).
            _editContext?.NotifyValidationStateChanged();
            if (Logger is not null) { LogCommandRejected(Logger, correlationId, ex.Message); }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            // Form disposed during submission; the Dispose path already handles state cleanup.
            if (!_disposed)
            {
                // Submit was cancelled without disposal -- reset lifecycle so the user can retry (patch P11).
                // Patch 2026-04-16 P-11: carry the submit correlation so sibling forms ignore this reset.
                Dispatcher.Dispatch(new IncrementCommandActions.ResetToIdleAction(correlationId));
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            admission.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public void Dispose()
    {
        // Idempotent dispose (patch P18). Blazor can invoke Dispose more than once on teardown.
        if (_disposed) return;
        _disposed = true;
        try { _cts?.Cancel(); } catch (ObjectDisposedException) { }
        _cts?.Dispose();
        _cts = null;
        if (_editContext is not null)
        {
            _editContext.OnFieldChanged -= OnEditContextFieldChanged;
        }
        LifecycleState.StateChanged -= OnStateChanged;
        System.GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
    }

            __b.AddAttribute(48, "aria-label", "Send IncrementCommand");
            // Enable submit in Idle, Confirmed, or Rejected (terminals allow retry) -- patch P3.
            __b.AddAttribute(49, "Disabled",
                !_interactiveReady
                || (LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Idle
                && LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Confirmed
                && LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Rejected));
            __b.AddAttribute(50, "ChildContent", (RenderFragment)(__btn =>
            {
                if (LifecycleState.Value.State == CommandLifecycleState.Submitting)
                {
                    __btn.OpenComponent<FluentSpinner>(0);
                    __btn.AddAttribute(1, "Style", "width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-right: 8px;");
                    __btn.CloseComponent();
                }
                __btn.AddContent(2, "Send IncrementCommand");
            }));
            __b.CloseComponent();
        });
            __wrap.AddAttribute(3, "ChildContent", formBody);
            __wrap.CloseComponent();
        }));
        builder.CloseComponent();
        builder.CloseElement();
    }


    /// <summary>Story 2-5 D4 — joins Fluxor-state Reason + Resolution with '. ' separator; null outside Rejected.</summary>
    private string? BuildFcLifecycleRejectionCopy()
    {
        if (LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Rejected) return null;
        var reason = LifecycleState.Value.RejectionReason;
        var resolution = LifecycleState.Value.RejectionResolution;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason) && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(resolution)) return null;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(resolution)) return reason;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason)) return resolution;
        return reason + ". " + resolution;
    }

    /// <summary>Story 2-5 D4 — domain-language rejection title ('{DisplayLabel} failed'); null outside Rejected.</summary>
    private string? BuildFcLifecycleRejectionTitle()
        => LifecycleState.Value.State == CommandLifecycleState.Rejected
           ? "Send IncrementCommand failed"
           : null;

    /// <summary>Story 3-4 — carries typed rejection metadata to the lifecycle wrapper.</summary>
    private CommandRejectionDetails? BuildFcLifecycleRejectionDetails()
    {
        if (LifecycleState.Value.State != CommandLifecycleState.Rejected) return null;
        return CommandRejectionDetails.FromOptional(
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionErrorCode,
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionReasonCategory,
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionSuggestedAction,
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionDocsCode,
            LifecycleState.Value.RejectionResolution);
    }


    private void OnAmountChanged(string? value)
    {
        _AmountString = value;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
        {
            _AmountParseError = "A number is required.";
            NotifyClientFieldChanged("Amount");
            return;
        }
        if (int.TryParse(value, NumberStyles.Integer | NumberStyles.AllowLeadingSign | NumberStyles.AllowTrailingWhite | NumberStyles.AllowLeadingWhite, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, out var parsed))
        {
            _model.Amount = parsed;
            _AmountParseError = null;
        }
        else
        {
            _AmountParseError = "Invalid number format.";
        }
        NotifyClientFieldChanged("Amount");
    }
